entities.summary: Stefan Schwarzmann (b. 1965-11-11, Erlangen) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Erlangen and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
